Hi,

Do you have check the impact for translation ? i think it is needed by translation stuff if remember

According to [Qt Documentation](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qobject.html#tr), the return value of `tr()` is `QString`. Therefore, it is unnecessary to wrap a `QString()` constructor around `tr()`.

I have checked the impact of translation, it works :)
